comments.text:
NIMBY local governments are such an under discussed part of housing shortages. We had the same problem in Sydney, Australia for a long time, until the New South Wales state government finally grew some chest hair and decided to exercise their right to overrule local governments.  

I take it that American states are unfortunately not as powerful as Australian states when it comes to dealing with local and federal governments. 

States are easily the most powerful level of government in Australia.  During COVID they started closing borders on each other and there was nothing the federal government could do. It’s basically 6 countries in a trench coat.
